Off duty at 4AM
Sleep 💤 @ 5AM
Started my day @ 9AM
To MOA @ 10AM
Arrived MOA @ around 11:30
Got in @apopcollections  around 12:45
FINISHED @ 1:10!!! 
Went to 8seconds and done shopping @ 1:45
Out of MOA @ 2PM → PITX → 🏡 @ 5:30

Shuta. HAHAHA naalala ko na naman yung SS7 uwian din kami ng ate ko. 😂 but back then, routes were okk??? Kasi nakasakay kami non 12MN karating kami samin 1:30 AM una kasi WALANG TRAFFIC also, EDSA kasi ang daan. 

TAPOS MAY ESSAY AKO DUE IN 5 hours. ☹️🫩😆

So tiring daaay but heart is full, and wallet is empty. 😂 Capping this day at student mode ang tao bukas. 🤓 #ksynotskyshenanigans
